Context: 7. Registration with Employment Exchange.-

8. Applications for employment in private or industrial firms.The employee is required either to resign or retire before applying for a post in private sector. He may submit resignation/voluntary retirement notice in case he is eligible, and ask for permission to apply for employment in the private sector pending the acceptance of resignation or expiry of the notice of retirement, as the case may be. Permission may be granted, if his retention in Government service is not necessary in the public interest.
